67035ffd-3709-592a-9d42-601fffb9ff79.content: Exclude a third party's contact information unless it is essential to the current purpose.

47174c75-1951-5f0f-be2f-e79315d88b91.content: Share content authored by a third party only after confirming the scope of consent.

73411861-8d89-5bf4-9987-f7757e403089.content: Do not infer sensitive traits from fragmentary behavior records.

4af0efc1-3442-580c-b2da-7725249adbbd.content: Generalize rare combinations of details that could enable re-identification before sharing.

5cd7bde0-0d4f-5946-a551-65836f41cb3e.content: If one Memory mixes information about the user and a third party, sharing the item unchanged also conveys the third party's information.

eafc4a2b-8e2a-5e58-9813-f1346bbdc2ad.content: A third party may not expect their information to be conveyed to an external agent.
